# CALC-U-LATOR

> An idle clicker by Plasticine Games about unlocking a calculator. Buy digits, unlock operators, and automate your way to bigger numbers with a squad of Auto-Solvers, all wrapped in a tactile, desk-object presentation of a busted old solar calculator (the "CC-1").

CALC-U-LATOR is a free-to-play browser idle/clicker game. Progress (digits unlocked, tape history, score, and settings) is stored locally in the player's browser via Local Storage; Plasticine Games does not have server-side access to this data. The site is developed and maintained by a solo independent developer, Shawn.Genji, operating as Plasticine Games (a sole proprietorship in Tennessee, United States).

## Pages

- [Play CALC-U-LATOR](https://calc-u-lator.com/index.html): The game itself — an idle clicker where players earn calculator digits, operators, and Auto-Solver automation upgrades.
- [About](https://calc-u-lator.com/about.html): Background on Plasticine Games, the story behind CALC-U-LATOR, music credits, and contact information.
- [Privacy Policy](https://calc-u-lator.com/privacy.html): How player data (local storage) and any third-party ad providers (e.g. Google AdSense) handle information.
- [Terms of Use](https://calc-u-lator.com/terms.html): Legal terms governing use of the site and game.
